upstreamAuthor: adelvillar1 (same author as the fork; Apache-2.0)
syncRule: upstream repos stay the development home; re-vendor by copying src/ and service/mcp_server.py at a recorded sha

fleetVendor.source: ~/Projects/sys1 branch feature/plan-surface at a landed commit
fleetVendor.note: Re-vendored from the branch's own commits (KI-029 closed): src/ and service/mcp_server.py are byte-exact to f0faebc EXCEPT src/sys1/perception.py, which is fleet's carry — the documents session's parse_document lives only in the upstream working tree (never landed on feature/plan-surface), so the copy keeps fleet HEAD's file; rsync ran without --delete for exactly this reason. The same carried-file pattern KI-003 named, on a new file, until the module lands upstream.

fleetAdditions.what: the `tool_route` task — one choice head id `capability` over the nine-class closed set plus `none`, the deferred-tool search's judgment
fleetAdditions.why: fleet's tool_search calls sys1_classify with task tool_route; the label set is the ranker's own class vocabulary (src/tool_router.rs class_terms), so the class the lane names is always one the ranker can act on

fleetAdditions.what: the `curate` task — three heads over one call: needs_recall (yes/no), focus (the corpus's 7 structure + 6 failure shapes + none), staleness (fresh/stale) — the memory curator's judgment
fleetAdditions.why: fleet's mid-run memory curation composes this verdict with its cosine drift floor; the text contract is a two-part pair (last-curated instruction + new steer) because the judgment is of the move, not one text
